title: The encoder block and the class-token readout
goal:
Implement two functions from Section 3.1, Equations 2 to 4.

`encoder_block(z, p)` computes

$$z'_\ell = \operatorname{MSA}(\operatorname{LN}(z_{\ell-1})) + z_{\ell-1}, \qquad z_\ell = \operatorname{MLP}(\operatorname{LN}(z'_\ell)) + z'_\ell$$

with LayerNorm *before* each sub-block (pre-LN) and a residual connection after it. `vit_readout(z0, blocks, g, b)` applies the blocks in order and returns the image representation $y = \operatorname{LN}(z_L^0)$ (Equation 4): the final LayerNorm of row 0, the class token.

The starter includes finished `layernorm`, `gelu`, `msa` (multi-head self-attention without a mask), and `mlp` (two layers with GELU between them). Each block is a dict of weights.
hints: Use `layernorm(z, p["g1"], p["b1"])` before `msa`, and `layernorm(z, p["g2"], p["b2"])` before `mlp`.
Each sub-block adds to its own input, not to the normalized one: `z = z + msa(layernorm(z, ...), p)`.
`vit_readout` returns a vector of shape `(D,)`, not the whole sequence. Normalize only row 0.
